items.name: fade-rise
items.title: Fade & rise
items.description: Content fades in and lifts gently into place as it scrolls into view.

items.name: stagger-children
items.title: Stagger children
items.description: Cascades a grid or list of children into view with a per-index delay.

items.name: directional-slide
items.title: Directional slide-in
items.description: Enters from the left, right, up or down — pair with feature rows.

items.name: blur-in
items.title: Blur-in
items.description: Resolves from a soft blur to sharp while fading in — great for media.

items.name: scale-in
items.title: Scale-in
items.description: Scales up from 0.96 to full size while fading in — pair with stat cards.

items.name: parallax-drift
items.title: Scroll parallax drift
items.description: A background layer drifts at a fraction of the scroll speed, travel capped.

items.name: bento-reveal
items.title: Bento reveal
items.description: A bento grid reveals with a shared spotlight and per-cell stagger as it enters view.

items.name: sticky-scroll
items.title: Sticky / pinned scroll
items.description: A panel pins while its content advances through steps; the progress bar tracks the scroll.

items.name: scroll-linked
items.title: Scroll-linked transforms
items.description: Two layers’ transform and opacity are bound to scroll position — modernised parallax.

items.name: gradient-sweep
items.title: Gradient sweep
items.description: An animated brand gradient sweeps continuously across a heading.

items.name: typewriter
items.title: Typewriter
items.description: Types and erases a rotating list of phrases, with a blinking caret.

items.name: word-stagger
items.title: Word stagger
items.description: Splits a line into words and reveals each one in sequence as it enters.

items.name: letter-decode
items.title: Letter decode
items.description: Scrambles then resolves characters left-to-right when scrolled into view.

items.name: highlight-sweep
items.title: Highlight sweep
items.description: A marker grows behind an emphasised word as the line scrolls into view.

items.name: circular-text
items.title: Circular text
items.description: Lays a string around a ring that slowly rotates, like a rotating seal.

items.name: text-flip
items.title: Text flip
items.description: Cycles a list of words, each flipping vertically (rotateX) in and out.

items.name: count-up
items.title: Count-up
items.description: Figures tween from 0 to their target when scrolled into view, with formatting.

items.name: odometer
items.title: Sliding number
items.description: Each digit rolls vertically to its target like a mechanical odometer when in view.

items.name: progress-fill
items.title: Progress fill
items.description: A DzProgress bar fills from 0 to its value the moment it scrolls into view.

items.name: rating-fill
items.title: Rating fill
items.description: A DzRating fills star-by-star when scrolled into view; final value under reduced motion.

items.name: aurora-drift
items.title: Aurora drift
items.description: Soft brand blobs drift on slow, offset loops behind a hero or CTA surface.

items.name: animated-grid
items.title: Animated grid/dots
items.description: A subtle line or dot pattern pans slowly behind a section as an ambient backdrop.

items.name: spotlight-follow
items.title: Spotlight follow
items.description: A radial light tracks the cursor across a surface; static glow under reduced motion.

items.name: gradient-border-glow
items.title: Gradient border glow
items.description: An animated conic-gradient ring glows around a card; static brand border when reduced.

items.name: meteors
items.title: Meteors
items.description: Diagonal shooting-star streaks cross a hero or card on offset loops; static when reduced.

items.name: particle-field
items.title: Particle field
items.description: A constellation of dots drifts, links near neighbours and eases aside under the pointer.

items.name: progressive-blur
items.title: Progressive blur
items.description: Layered backdrop-filter stops fade a scroll edge; opaque surface fade under reduced transparency.

items.name: glass-surface
items.title: Glass surface
items.description: A frosted panel over a busy backdrop; opaque raised surface when transparency is reduced.

items.name: card-lift
items.title: Card lift + glow
items.description: A card rises with a soft shadow and a brand-tinted border on hover.

items.name: tilt
items.title: 3D tilt
items.description: A card tilts toward the pointer with depth and an optional glare highlight.

items.name: sheen-sweep
items.title: Sheen sweep
items.description: A diagonal light streak sweeps across a button or card on hover.

items.name: magnetic-button
items.title: Magnetic button
items.description: A CTA eases toward the cursor within a small radius and springs back on leave.

items.name: border-beam
items.title: Border beam
items.description: A light beam travels continuously around a card’s border on a loop.

items.name: dock
items.title: Dock magnification
items.description: A row of icons scales by pointer proximity, neighbours easing — the macOS dock.

items.name: card-stack
items.title: Card stack / swap
items.description: Stacked cards cycle the front card to the back — morphs via View Transitions, FLIPs otherwise.

items.name: glare
items.title: Glare card
items.description: A glossy specular highlight tracks the pointer across a card — the gloss, no tilt.

items.name: custom-cursor
items.title: Custom cursor
items.description: A soft blob trails the pointer inside a region; native cursor returns on leave.

items.name: image-compare
items.title: Image comparison
items.description: Drag — or arrow-key — a handle to wipe between a before and after image.

items.name: lens
items.title: Lens / magnifier
items.description: A magnified circle follows the pointer over an image, locking onto what is under it.

items.name: stagger-list-in
items.title: Stagger list-in
items.description: List items enter one-by-one on view — pair with avatars, lists or menus.

items.name: marquee-strip
items.title: Marquee strip
items.description: A logo/badge strip scrolls infinitely and seamlessly; hover to pause.

items.name: flip-on-change
items.title: Flip on change
items.description: A badge value flips with a half-turn whenever the underlying data updates.

items.name: auto-animate-list
items.title: Auto-animate list
items.description: Add, remove and reorder list items animate in one line via AutoAnimate; snaps when reduced.

items.name: pulse-ping
items.title: Pulse / ping
items.description: An expanding ring radiates from a status dot to draw the eye to live updates.

items.name: shimmer-skeleton
items.title: Shimmer skeleton
items.description: A soft highlight sweeps across loading placeholders to signal progress.

items.name: toast-slide-in
items.title: Toast slide-in
items.description: Toasts enter and stack with a slide + fade; appear instantly when reduced.

items.name: success-check
items.title: Success check
items.description: An SVG ring and tick draw themselves in with a small pop to confirm a completed action.

items.name: confetti-burst
items.title: Confetti burst
items.description: A celebratory multi-colour particle pop fires on a milestone action; a no-op when reduced.

items.name: error-shake
items.title: Error shake
items.description: A field rejects invalid input with a damped horizontal shake plus the red invalid state.

items.name: like-pop
items.title: Like pop
items.description: A like toggle pops in scale and radiates a ring of colour sparks on the rising edge.

items.name: route-transition
items.title: Route transition
items.description: Pages fade and slide as you navigate between routes; instant under reduced motion.

items.name: tabs-indicator-slide
items.title: Tabs indicator slide
items.description: The active-tab underline glides between tabs; instant move under reduced motion.

items.name: accordion-height
items.title: Accordion height
items.description: Panels expand and collapse on a smooth height transition; instant under reduced motion.

items.name: presence-exit
items.title: Presence exit
items.description: A closing element stays mounted so a pure-CSS leave animation plays before unmount; instant when reduced.

items.name: animated-beam
items.title: Animated beam
items.description: A light gradient travels an SVG path connecting two referenced elements.

items.name: orbiting-icons
items.title: Orbiting icons
items.description: Avatars and badges orbit a central hub on one or more slow-spinning rings.

items.name: morphing-dialog
items.title: Morphing dialog
items.description: A card expands into a dialog sharing its box — morphs via View Transitions, FLIPs otherwise.

items.name: dynamic-island
items.title: Dynamic island
items.description: A compact pill morphs to reveal expanded content and back; sizes via interpolate-size, FLIPs otherwise.

items.name: native-popover-entrance
items.title: Native popover entrance
items.description: A menu/tooltip opens via the Popover API, animating in from @starting-style; <Transition> fallback.
